integrity: All-size identities are supported by an analytical proof and supplemented by standalone exact-rational checks; mathematical independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to standard random-permutation binary search trees and to the exact mixed covariance between squared root imbalance and individual fringe-size counts. It does not prove stochastic order or nonstandard insertion laws. The basic root decomposition and means are classical; historical priority of the evaluated mixed-moment spectrum is not guaranteed.
title: The two-thirds covariance threshold for fringe subtree sizes in random binary search trees
